title: F26 工具 ▾ 里的“立即推进一步”（只看不点）

steps.js: const b=document.querySelector('[data-tool=tick]'); const all=[...document.querySelectorAll('.v3-tools button, .v3-tools a')].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean); return {tick: b ? {txt:b.innerText, title:b.title, vis:b.getBoundingClientRect().width>0} : null, items: all.slice(0,60)}

title: P1-2 顶栏卡数 / GPU 面板 与连接胶囊一致

steps.js: const g=document.querySelector('.v3-gpu'); return {gpu:g?.innerText, gpuTitle:g?.title?.slice(0,400), chip:document.querySelector('.infra-pop button')?.innerText, chipTitle:document.querySelector('.infra-pop button')?.title?.slice(0,120)}

title: P0-2 / P1-1 画布 ep06（后端未重启前预计仍复现）

steps.js: const imgs=[...document.querySelectorAll('img')].filter(i=>i.getBoundingClientRect().width>100).map(i=>decodeURIComponent(i.currentSrc||i.src).replace(/.*src=/,'').slice(0,100)); const draft=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0 && /草图/.test(e.innerText||'')).length; const vid=[...document.querySelectorAll('*')].filter(e=>e.children.length===0 && /视频 \d+ 版待选/.test(e.innerText||'')).length; return {imgs, draftLabels:draft, videoPending:vid}

title: r43 整洁版总览 + 单击开抽屉

steps.clickAt: (()=>{const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('img.live-img')].find(i=>i.getBoundingClientRect().width>40 && i.getBoundingClientRect().top>200); if(!t) return [null,null]; const r=t.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x+r.width/2, r.y+r.height/2]})()

steps.js: const d=[...document.querySelectorAll('aside, [role=dialog], [class*=peek], [class*=drawer]')].filter(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect().width>200); return {hash: location.hash, drawers: d.map(x=>({cls:x.className, txt:x.innerText.slice(0,500)}))}
